exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: prompt.global_gap: at least 15 minutes between any two prompts

inputBoundary: One caller-supplied finite nonnegative elapsed duration in minutes between the immediately previous emitted prompt and one already-triggered candidate prompt.
outputBoundary: Suppress the candidate below fifteen elapsed minutes and permit it at equality or above; this is only the global inter-prompt gap decision.
limitations: The source does not define the no-prior-prompt case, process versus persisted state scope, restart behavior, or whether prompt means scheduled, displayed, or successfully delivered; a missing prior-gap value fails closed in this binding.

The source does not disclose clock source, timestamp resolution, timezone handling, monotonicity, rounding, or tolerance, so the caller supplies an already-derived elapsed duration and no sub-minute policy is inferred.
Time-triggered, calendar, connectivity, message, call, and voluntary trigger detection and collision or priority handling occur before this boundary.
The neighboring connectivity-change rule is a separate five-minute, screen-active guard and is not generalized into or replaced by this fifteen-minute global gap.
Prompt delivery across phone and watch, MDMQ response handling, and study-procedure behavior are outside this gate.
No study-version source, dataset, scheduler trace, or machine-readable source oracle was found; this fixture proves the disclosed threshold logic, not the complete prompt state machine.
